turns.text: Founder-CTO building and selling at the same time is a tough combination. Wanted to connect with someone navigating both sides of that.
Running product and pipeline as a Founder-CTO means one of them usually loses. Which one's taking the hit right now?

Hi Sam,

Pipeline is probably the bigger challenge at the moment. The product side is progressing well, but finding the right customers and scaling distribution is a different game. What do you have in mind?

Glad you asked. Vantera is our product, this system finds intent from your target audience such as likes, comments, posts and activity. Then it will qualify it as a lead based on how much value you provide. Vantera will send personalize messages not templates for each lead in your pipeline.
Quality and personalize with your audiences pain points is what converts not strandardized messaging. That is our solution for LinkedIn outreach.
The outreach message sent to you was form our system. If you have any further question you can ask here or visit our website:)

Vantera automates that side of it, AI finds in-market prospects, drafts personalized messages, and scores leads, you just approve before anything sends. Founders usually get 10+ qualified meetings a week without adding headcount. Happy to walk you through how it works if you're curious.
